detail.longDescription: I have a docker compose file and Dockerfile for a Node.js project with yarn, and I'm unable to build with dependencies behind a VPN. Minimum reproduceable example on my machine. services: mre-test: build: context: . dockerfile_inline: | FROM node:26.10.0-slim WORKDIR /app RUN echo "registry=http://npm.foo-bar.com" > .npmrc RUN npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund yarn@1.22.22 RUN yarn init --yes RUN yarn add @foo-bar/custom-package command: "tail -f /dev/null" The error message. > [6/6] RUN yarn add @foo-bar/custom-package: 0.373 yarn add v1.22.22 0.389 info No lockfile found. 0.410 [1/4] Resolving packages... 0.510 info There appears to be trouble with your network connection. Retrying... 3.575 info There appears to be trouble with your network connection. Retrying... 6.870 info There appears to be trouble with your network connection. Retrying... 9.934 info There appears to be trouble with your network connection. Retrying... 13.01 info Visit https://yarnpkg.com/en/docs/cli/add for documentation about this command. 13.01 error Error: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND npm.foo-bar.com So there is npm.foo-bar.com , a custom registry with packages. I can't access it during the build. The VPN is running on my host machine. I have commented out the line RUN yarn add @foo-bar/custom-package . Let the container build, run apt install iputils-ping and then do ping npm.foo-bar.com . I can ping the registry fine from my host and inside the container, so I'm pretty sure the VPN is connected. I don't understand why the docker build is unable to access the services behind a VPN. OS info: OS: Arch x64 Docker version 29.8.2, build 7fc2dff9bc Docker Compose version 5.6.0
